verdict_rule: CHAIN_CONNECTED only when provenance pins hold before any case executes, every case is MET (reached its stage with its specific evidence), no journaled job is left in an unverified (UNKNOWN) state and, live, every submitted job (pointer lookup, pin resolution, head observation, payload rows, retrieval, declaration, receipt) carries one known user_email; CHAIN_INCOMPLETE when a case never reached its stage (outage on any leg, including approved) or a job's server state was never reconciled; CHAIN_BROKEN when a reached stage contradicts the expectation, a payload is inconsistent with the pinned publication, or a pin/seed refuses (stale, invalid, unavailable, out of scope)
